text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I passed by the front of the dorm, for 
some reason, several large trucks were 
parked there.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's everyone! Tarumae, grab 
the cups! Oguri and Yukino, take the 
plates! Let's haul 'em to the cafeteria~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Then all that's left is to carry the 
ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san, want to join in? It's the 
"Eat All the Local Flavors Fest"!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Gifts arrived from everyone's hometowns. 
We were just talking about how we should 
all eat them together.
choice_data_list: Don't tell me this entire truck is... !?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we had them all hauled by truck. 
About one truckload per person, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Jajamen, wanko soba~♪ That really was a 
staggering amount that arrived, wasn't 
it?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Chewy, chewy surf clams~♪ The taste of 
home really revitalizes the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
With this much food, adding one more 
person won't be an issue. It's 
all-you-can-eat refills.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's turn the taste of our 
far-off homeland into pure muscle for our 
bodies!
choice_data_list:
Why don't we share some to promote the 
local area?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, true that! Luckily, we've got plenty 
of food!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I think everyone back home would be happy 
to see so many horse girls eating it, too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'll go grab permission from the 
student council real quick!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Unbranded, generic grilled carrots! The 
person who grew them is a neighborhood 
friend of mine!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, forget 'Grown by this person,' it's 
'I know who grew this'! I'd love to go eat 
some fresh-picked produce, too.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha! When that time comes, leave the 
guiding to me! My whole family'll give you 
a proper welcome, you hear?

Afterward, the mini local product fair 
hosted by Katsuragi Ace was a huge hit, 
leaving the Umamusume from regional areas 
very pleased.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Oooh!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Keep up with the rhythm of the music! Down 
goes the wanko soba, one bowl after 
another♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
So good! Pickles and surf clams go great 
together, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Katsuragi Ace and the other 
Umamusume with deep hometown pride 
heartily devoured the flavors of their 
homes.
